remainingGaps.providers: Weather, news, calendar and maps are frozen fixtures; current provider availability, network behavior and hardware rendering are outside this gate.
remainingGaps.hub: Full HubService orchestration, proactive transactions and unhosted external cloud actions are outside this component profile; the baseline retains 97 side-specific external-action gap instances (8 reference, 89 candidate; 91 unique cases).
remainingGaps.originalTests: The 950 original test declarations and 960 expanded source cases remain separate inventory obligations. The production suite does not claim to execute every original test file, hook or historical external integration.
remainingGaps.phoenixResult: The reviewed Phoenix baseline is a mismatch with 49,155 field differences and zero invariant failures; it is intentionally partial coverage rather than a complete gate.

notes: Counts retain every entry/command occurrence and each corpus denominator; exact string duplicates are reported, not discarded.
Missing intent/entity fields mean missing manifest expectations, not a no-match requirement.
Conditional prompt branches are counted separately from base commands; no historical execution is inferred.

Partial coverage means the source-pinned production-v2 pipeline executed the named occurrences and retained a reviewed differential. It does not mean Phoenix passed the comparison or that provider, HubService and original-test gaps are closed.
